bio: Originally from Waco, TX, Ria is excited to make Boston her home. She earned an honors BS in Biochemistry and a BA in Plan II Honors from the University of Texas at Austin. Ria was deeply involved on campus as a Senior Resident Assistant, a role that earned her the 2023 National Student Employee of the Year Award for Diversity. As a medical student, Ria serves on the Massachusetts Chapter of the American Academy of Pediatrics Medical Student Committee and is co-director of the 2025 Harvard Medical School M1 Music Video. She is most looking forward to creating longitudinal relationships with freshmen to help them reach their full potential. Outside of her academic and professional pursuits, Ria enjoys puzzles, hiking, reading, and cafe-hopping. Community Yards Crimson Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
